android.desc:
Looking for a LudoKing-style experience but built for chess lovers? RookTook is the fastest way to play chess online, compete in 2 Min puzzle tournaments and unlock rewards.

Join 2-minute chess puzzles where players compete live on the same board. Climb the leaderboard, challenge friends and prove your skills in formats like 1v1 battles, winner-takes-all and Open Sunday tournaments.

Unlike endless casual play, every match in RookTook is a real competition. Play chess, solve puzzles and compete with your talent in exciting new formats designed for casual and amateur players.

Features:

1. Live 2-minute puzzle tournaments

2. 1v1, Winner-Takes-All & Open Sunday Puzzle formats

3. Real time leaderboards to track your performance

4. Unlock real rewards if you win

Download RookTook now and experience chess online like never before - faster, more thrilling and more rewarding.

ABOUT ROOKTOOK.COM
RookTook.com is a free-to-play chess platform where players play, progress and compete.

YouTube: http://www.youtube.com/@playrooktook
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playrooktook
